status: Reference designs, not implemented or load-tested

diagrams.title: A1 | Buildable single-region architecture
diagrams.caption: Render compute with managed synchronous Multi-AZ PostgreSQL. Render Postgres asynchronous HA is only a separately disclosed sandbox shortcut.

diagrams.title: A2 | Purchase, approval and payment flow
diagrams.caption: Internal approval and PayPal buyer approval are separate. Remote calls occur outside database transactions.

diagrams.title: A3 | Capture-operation state machine
diagrams.caption: State applies to one logical capture operation. Refunds are separate capture-linked operations; they do not rewind this machine.

diagrams.title: A4 | Authoritative data model
diagrams.caption: Tenant-scoped keys and immutable versions. Relationship labels describe cardinality; all foreign keys also carry tenant identity.

diagrams.title: A5 | Trust and authority boundaries
diagrams.caption: OWASP-aligned control design, not a security certification. External content never grants authority.

diagrams.title: A6 | Independent verification harness
diagrams.caption: Production rules may be shared across UI/server. The test oracle must not simply call those same production checks and certify itself.

diagrams.title: B1 | Regional cells and separate financial durability
diagrams.caption: Reference production design. Repeat cells by tenant/authority scope; do not interpret three drawn cells as a capacity benchmark.

diagrams.title: B2 | Consistency, budgets and ownership
diagrams.caption: CAP is selected per operation. Serializable transactions do not atomically include PayPal or a fulfillment provider.

diagrams.title: B3 | Traffic admission and backpressure
diagrams.caption: Bounded queues, fair quotas and provider limits control load. More workers do not increase PayPal's contracted capacity.

diagrams.title: B4 | Fenced failover and ambiguous payments
diagrams.caption: Fencing stops new stale dispatch through our gateway. It cannot cancel a request already accepted by PayPal.

diagrams.title: B5 | Funds boundary and reconciliation
diagrams.caption: Assembly Proof stores instructions and financial references. PayPal / the licensed provider handles funds; this design is not a custodial wallet.

diagrams.title: B6 | Regional security and operational isolation
diagrams.caption: Use versioned OWASP ASVS requirements, API threat tests and GenAI controls. No diagram proves the absence of vulnerabilities.

diagrams.title: S1 | All ten sponsors with bounded responsibilities
diagrams.caption: The same ownership split applies to both architectures. A meaningful integration needs a working contribution; these remain proposed.

diagrams.title: S2 | Business value and loss guardrails
diagrams.caption: Hypotheses to measure in a merchant pilot. No conversion lift, loss reduction, profit or first-prize probability is established.
